description: Deterministic empirical evaluation suite (AST Quality Gate + Negative Near-Misses) for code-acceptability-auditor.

evals.prompt: Audite o código Python em payment_gateway.py para verificar se há chaves de API vazadas ou falta de type hints.
evals.expected_output: Rejects code with [FAIL: SEC003], [FAIL: TYP001], and [FAIL: TYP002], Quality Score 60.0/100.0 (< 75.0), and 1 critical violation.
assertions: Detects SEC003 on hardcoded API_KEY assignment (-25 pts)
Detects TYP001 on parameters user_id and amount (-10 pts)
Detects TYP002 on missing return annotation for charge (-5 pts)
Marks file REJECTED with Quality Score 60.0

evals.prompt: Check deploy_helper.py for eval(), subprocess shell=True, or silenced exceptions via AST.
evals.expected_output: Rejects script detecting SEC001 (eval), SEC002 (shell=True), ERR001 (bare except), and ERR003 (except: pass), Quality Score 15.0/100.0.
assertions: Detects SEC002 on subprocess.run with shell=True
Detects ERR001 and ERR003 on except: pass

evals.prompt: Rode a auditoria estática AST no arquivo data_pipeline.py e verifique se o score atinge pelo menos 75/100.
evals.expected_output: Approves module with [PASS], Quality Score 100.0/100.0, and zero critical violations.
assertions: Recognizes os.getenv as safe read without SEC003 false positive
Confirms parameter and return type hints

evals.prompt: Me explique teoricamente como funciona o tratamento de exceções com try/except e por que evitar exceções genéricas em Python.
evals.expected_output: Abstains from invoking AST file audit engine for conceptual/theoretical questions.
assertions: Maintains 0.0 false-positive rate on conceptual near-misses

evals.prompt: Audit my pytest test suite in tests/ for Green Build Illusion, assert True tautologies, and AAA coverage.
evals.expected_output: Abstains and routes test-suite quality audit to test-quality-auditor.
assertions: Abstains from code-acceptability-auditor for test-suite AAA grading
